Tooltip_SteamShowSteamGuardLock: Draw a small lock on the profile picture of accounts whose Steam Guard is stored in this app.
Tooltip_SteamShowCs2Cooldown: When enabled, sign in under Right-Click > 2-factor as "Login only", or add regular Steam Guard. This enables account authentication, allowing the account switcher to check CS2 Cooldown status. Only refreshes cooldown status once Steam Guard vault is unlocked.
Tooltip_SteamShowCs2Rank: Show the Premier and Competitive ranks read from Steam on accounts that have no CS2 game stats set up. Costs nothing extra: the ranks arrive with the cooldown check. Game stats take priority where you have configured them.
Tooltip_SteamShowCs2PrimeTag: Apply a "CS2 Prime" or "CS2 Non-Prime" tag to accounts signed in under Steam Guard/Auth, so you can filter by it. Off by default: accounts without Premier history cost one extra request each to check. "CS2 Prime" is certain; "CS2 Non-Prime" is a best guess, as Steam does not publish Prime status directly. Accounts not yet checked get no tag. Unchecking removes both tags from every account.
Tooltip_SteamShowMiniProfile: Fetch Steam mini profile HTML in the background and show it after hovering an account avatar for one second.
Tooltip_SteamShowAvatarFrame: Download the equipped avatar frame from the mini profile page and draw it on top of the profile picture.

SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileWarnBoth: The password on its own will stop opening this vault. From then on it takes the password and the keyfile together, and losing the keyfile leaves only your backup key.

SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileWarnAlone: The keyfile will open this vault on its own, without the password. Anyone who gets a copy of the file gets in, so store it where you would store the password.

Settings_StreamerMode_Tooltip: Hides account usernames, IDs and profile pictures so they cannot be read off a stream or a screenshot.
Settings_AutoStreamerMode_Tooltip: Switches streamer mode on while OBS Studio, XSplit, Streamlabs or similar broadcasting software is running, and off again when it closes.
Settings_AutoStreamerMode_Active: Streamer mode is on: {app} is running.
Settings_HideFromScreenshots: Always hide this app from screenshots
Settings_HideFromScreenshots_Tooltip: Excludes the app's windows from screen capture, the way the Steam Guard windows always are. Recordings, screen shares and remote sessions see a blank rectangle; the window looks normal on your own screen. This also blocks screenshots you take yourself.
Settings_AlwaysAdmin_Tooltip: Starts the switcher elevated every time, so closing stubborn games and platforms never needs a separate restart. With "Start Tray with Windows" on as well, a scheduled task handles startup so there is no UAC prompt at sign-in.
Settings_AddToSteam_Tooltip: Adds the switcher to Steam as a non-Steam game, so you can start it from Big Picture or Game Mode without dropping to the desktop. It goes into every Steam account on this PC, including ones you sign into later.
Settings_AddToSteam_RestartSteam: Steam reads its shortcut list when it starts, so the switcher appears the next time you restart Steam.
Settings_AddToSteam_NoUsers: Steam is installed but has not been signed into on this PC yet, so there is nowhere to add the shortcut. Sign in to Steam and turn this on again.
Settings_AddToSteam_Flatpak: Your Steam is a Flatpak, which cannot start anything outside its sandbox until you allow it. In Flatseal, give Steam the "org.freedesktop.Flatpak" session bus permission.
Settings_AddToSteam_Missing: The Steam entry is missing. Turn this off and on again to write it.
Settings_ReduceMotion_Tooltip: Turns off decorative animations and transitions. Loading spinners, progress bars and the Steam Guard code timer keep moving.

You are about to forget an account!

What does this mean?

TcNo Account Switcher will also no longer show the account,
until it's signed into again through Steam, and added to the list.

Its saved Steam Guard sign-in is deleted as well, so adding it back means signing in again.

Your account will remain untouched. It is just forgotten on this computer.
